reason: I already check job boards and company pages, and I don't want to host or configure another app just to keep doing that. I also can't tell from this pitch how reliably it shows current dates and deadlines.
objection: Would I be able to trust the posting dates and deadlines, or would I still need to verify every listing myself?
would_change_my_mind: A simple hosted trial with clear source-by-source freshness and deadlines, so I can see it saves time before setting anything up.
